modules.name: Additional Armor
modules.description: It can be made from scrap metal or anything else the crew can get their hands on and fit to purpose.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots.
modules.benefit: Increases Vehicle’s Defense by 2 and Special Defense by 1.

modules.name: Armarouge-Pattern Plasma Cannon
modules.description: This smaller variant of the Clawitzer-Pattern Plasma Cannon still packs a hefty punch. Originally designed for Mechs, it can be modified for other Vehicles easily enough.
modules.requires: 4 Module Slots. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Plasma Shot
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Must Recharge. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn (2). If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Breach.

modules.name: Ballista
modules.description: This powerful Weapon resembling a giant crossbow can be mounted on any suitably large Vehicle.
modules.requires: 4 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.

commands.name: Ballistae Shot
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. High Critical.

modules.name: Boarding Teleporter
modules.description: This highly advanced device allows instant short range transmission of up to 3 Crew, aboard a nearby vessel or location. Once teleported, the device stores their bio-signature so they may be recalled safely at will.
modules.requires: 10 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above. Z-Space Drive and either Powered or Eldritch Traits.

commands.name: Boarding Teleport
commands.effect: Allow up to 3 Crew to Board the Target Vehicle or location.

modules.name: Cannon Battery
modules.description: Three cannons that fire large rounds towards the enemy.
modules.requires: 8 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above.

commands.name: Broadside Blitz
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Successive Actions. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Breach.
commands.requires: 10 Crew; 16 Crew if Size Category Huge or above.

modules.name: Ceruledge-Pattern Blade
modules.description: A huge powered sword-like attachment designed to be fitted to Mechs.
modules.requires: 4 Module Slots. Powered and Mech Traits.

commands.name: Power Cutter
commands.effect: Cutter Command. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Disable the Foe Vehicle’s last Command.

modules.name: Charizard’s Breath Cannon
modules.description: This elegant Weapon, often styled to look like the head of a Charizard, emits a gout of white-hot flame and can be mounted on any suitable Vehicle.
modules.requires: 5 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.

commands.name: Charizard’s Breath
commands.effect: Ranged. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Burn (1). If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 5 Chance Dice to Set Ablaze.

modules.name: Cryogonal-Pattern Cryogun
modules.description: This unusual Weapon is designed more for taking out infantry than other Vehicles, though it can still seize the moving parts of enemy Vehicles if applied directly.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Cryofreeze
commands.effect: Ranged. Roll 3 Chance Dice to Frostbite the Foe. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to make the Foe Vehicle Stuck.

modules.name: Clawitzer-Pattern Plasma Cannon
modules.description: This arcane Weapon launches high-energy ionized gas at the Foe, melting through titanium or steel as if they were butter.
modules.requires: 9 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Plasma Blast
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Must Recharge. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Burn (2). If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Breach.

modules.name: Dedicated Power-Supply
modules.description: This bulky power storage system generates and stores power slowly over time, ready for when you absolutely need that extra jolt.
modules.requires: 8 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above. Powered Trait.
modules.benefit: Other Equipment Modules with the Slow Charge (X) Trait become Slow Charge (1).

commands.name: Divert Power to Shields
commands.effect: Increase the Vehicle’s Defense and Special Defense by 2. Decrease the Vehicle’s Strength and Special by 2.
commands.requires: Deflector-Shields or Energy-Shields Equipment Module. 2 Crew.

commands.name: Divert Power to Weapons
commands.effect: Increase the Vehicle’s Strength and Special by 2. Decrease the Vehicle’s Defense and Special Defense by 2.

modules.name: Deflector-Shields
modules.description: These are the most common type of shields. They can soften the blow or, in many cases, entirely prevent Damage from everything from physical projectiles and explosions to space-debris collisions.
modules.requires: 6 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Activate Deflector-Shields
commands.effect: Shield Command. Reaction 5. Reduce by 5 the Damage from a Physical source.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 2 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

modules.name: Dragapult-Pattern Missile Launcher
modules.description: This missile launcher is a favourite among battle-worn captains. Its missiles home in on their Target via an encrypted tracking signal; even the best pilots or hackers would struggle to survive both shots.
modules.requires: 6 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Missile Barrage
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Never Miss. Double Action. Must Recharge. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Breach.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 4 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

modules.name: Dreepy-Pattern Torpedo Launcher
modules.description: This Weapon, patterned after the Dreepy line, is deadly and sends out many torpedoes in quick succession. “At least one of ’em’s gotta hit something, right?”
modules.requires: 6 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Torpedo Barrage
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Successive Actions. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Breach.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 4 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

modules.name: Dual Lasers
modules.description: Two smaller laser weapons that can be fitted easily, either on swivels or facing forward.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.
modules.traits: Slow Charge (3). Grants the Armed Trait.

commands.name: Dual Shot
commands.effect: Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Double Action. Roll 1 Chance Dice to ignore Defenses.

modules.name: Energy-Shields
modules.description: These are the most common type of energy shields. They can soften the blow or, in many cases, entirely prevent Damage from everything from energy weapons and Pokémon attacks to plasma storms.
modules.requires: 6 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Activate Energy-Shields
commands.effect: Shield Command. Reaction 5. Reduce by 5 the Damage from a Special source.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 2 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

modules.name: Excadrill-Pattern Mining Drill
modules.description: A large drill-like attachment designed for Mechs. More than a few asteroid miners have used them as improvised weapons when their operations came under attack.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Powered and Mech Traits.
modules.benefit: May be used to mine ore or dig tunnels.

commands.name: Drill-Punch
commands.effect: Fist Command. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Breach.

modules.name: Heavy Cannon
modules.description: This large cannon fires explosive-filled rounds that detonate on impact.
modules.requires: 7 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above.

commands.name: Explosive Round
commands.effect: Explosive Command. Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 2 Dice of Damage against 2 other Targets. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Breach.

modules.name: Heavy Laser-Cannon
modules.description: This robust cannon is commonplace, its hard-wearing nature and reliability make it a favourite.
modules.requires: 8 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.
modules.traits: Slow Charge (3). Grants the Armed Trait.

commands.name: Heavy Laser
commands.effect: Ranged. Lethal. High Critical. Roll 1 Chance Dice to ignore Defenses.

modules.name: Grappling Harpoons
modules.description: Simple grapples that allow the Crew to climb onto an enemy vessel or abseil down to a nearby location.
modules.requires: 2 Module Slots.

commands.name: Harpoon
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Blocks. Allows Crew to climb aboard the Foe Vehicle.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

modules.name: Heavy Machine Gun
modules.description: Deadly against infantry or lightly armored Vehicles, but less effective against heavily armored foes.
modules.requires: 4 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.

commands.name: Gun Them Down
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Successive Actions.

modules.name: Ion Pulse-Cannon
modules.description: This unique Weapon does not Damage Vehicles directly; instead, it disables them temporarily. It is a favourite among pirate captains and those looking to capture an enemy craft.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above. Powered Trait.
modules.traits: Energy Weapon (Ion). Grants the Armed Trait.

commands.name: Ion Pulse
commands.effect: Pulse Command. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Disable the Foe Vehicle’s last Command.

modules.name: Joltik-Pattern Power Leechers
modules.description: A strange series of projectile cables that sap the energy of enemy Vehicles.
modules.requires: 2 Module Slots. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Power Steal
commands.effect: Blocks. Reduce the Foe’s Dexterity by 1. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Leech the Target.

modules.name: Machamp-Pattern Power Gauntlet
modules.description: A huge powered fist-like attachment designed to be fitted to Mechs.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Powered and Mech Traits.

commands.name: Lightning Punch
commands.effect: Fist Command. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Paralyze the Foe. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 4 Chance Dice to Overload the Foe.

modules.name: Mini Cannon
modules.description: This small cannon fires solid shot that can still deal severe Damage.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.

commands.name: Cannon Shot
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Breach.

modules.name: Multi-Laser
modules.description: Great against infantry or smaller Vehicles. Occasionally, a skilled shot will get lucky and manage to down something bigger.
modules.requires: 5 Module Slots. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Double Blast
commands.effect: Ranged. High Critical. Double Action. Roll 1 Chance Dice to ignore Defenses.

modules.name: Pintle Mounted Gun
modules.description: It can’t compete with larger scale weapons, but it will certainly deter those who may approach.
modules.requires: 3 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.

commands.name: Burst Fire
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Double Action.

modules.name: Shipboard Armory
modules.description: “A well-stocked armory and troops who know how to use it. We’ll see off our enemies any day they try and pick a fight with us, Ma’am.”
modules.requires: 7 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above.
modules.benefit: NPC Crew may be outfitted with Firearms and Leather / Flak Armor (at the Storyteller’s discretion).

commands.name: Arquebus Volley
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Lethal. Roll Damage Dice according to the Vehicle’s Rank.
commands.requires: Crew equal to the Vehicle’s Current Rank.

modules.name: Shipboard Archers
modules.description: “Pick your targets... Hold... On my signal... Fire!”
modules.requires: 6 Module Slots. Size Category Medium or above.
modules.benefit: NPC Crew may be outfitted with Bows and Leather Armor, with braziers lit for fire arrows.

commands.name: Fire-Arrow Volley
commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Roll Damage Dice according to the Vehicle’s Rank. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Set Ablaze. If the Target is a human or Pokémon: Roll 3 Chance Dice to Burn (1).
commands.requires: Crew equal to the Vehicle’s Current Rank.

modules.name: Weavile-Pattern Power Claw
modules.description: Powered, bladed claw-like attachments designed to be fitted to Mechs.
modules.requires: 4 Module Slots. Powered Trait.

commands.name: Power Claw
commands.effect: Successive Actions. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 1 Chance Dice to Disable.

modules.name: Z-Space Drive
modules.description: The invention that took humanity (and their Pokémon companions) beyond the reach of the solar system and out into the galaxy. It allows a ship to bypass the distances needed for conventional travel, by venturing through the mysterious realm known as Z-Space, a place originally only accessible through Ultra Wormholes.
modules.requires: 12 Module Slots. Size Category Large or above. Powered and Space Traits.

commands.name: Z-Space Shift
commands.effect: Reaction 1. The Vehicle can now make up to 3 Evades this Round.
commands.requires: 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Cunning Maneuver
general_commands.effect: Increase the User’s Strength and Dexterity by 1. Reduce the User’s Defense and Special Defense by 1. Duration 3 Turns.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Feign Defeat
general_commands.effect: This Command can only be used after the Target rolls Damage against the User. User’s next 3 Commands gain Reaction 3.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Horrifying Presence
general_commands.effect: Reduce the Will of those affected by half (rounded down). Reset any effects the Targets received from spending Will previously.

general_commands.name: Insightful Maneuver
general_commands.effect: Shield Command. Reaction 1. Reduce by 3 the Damage this Vehicle would receive from a Damaging attack.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Man The Oars
general_commands.effect: Increase the Vehicle’s Dexterity and Evasion by 2. Reduce the Vehicle’s Strength by 2. Duration 3 Turns.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 6 Crew if Medium, 12 Crew if Large, or 22 Crew if Huge.

general_commands.name: Overclock
general_commands.effect: Reaction 1. Increase the Vehicle’s Dexterity by 2. Duration 3 Turns.
general_commands.requires: Powered Trait. 1 Crew; 3 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Pokémon Assault
general_commands.effect: Ranged. Roll Damage Dice according to the Vehicle’s Rank. The Damage Type is decided by the specific Pokémon Types chosen, or roll 1d18 to determine the Damage Type. (1. Fire, 2. Fighting, 3. Rock, 4. Ground, 5. Electric, 6. Bug, 7. Grass, 8. Flying, 9. Ice, 10. Water, 11. Dragon, 12. Ghost, 13. Poison, 14. Psychic, 15. Fairy, 16. Normal, 17. Steel, 18. Dark).
general_commands.requires: Pokémon Crew equal to the Vehicle’s Current Rank.

general_commands.name: Possessed Rigging
general_commands.effect: Reduce the Dexterity of those affected by 1. This Command may only Target Active Combatants aboard the Vehicle itself.

general_commands.name: Quick-Fix
general_commands.effect: Basic Heal. Heal 3 HP when used by a Small or Medium Size Category Vehicle. Heal 6 HP when used by a Large or Huge Size Category Vehicle.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 5 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Ram
general_commands.effect: Recoil. If the Target is an applicable Vehicle: Roll 2 Chance Dice to Breach.
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 4 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Roto-Recover
general_commands.effect: Remove one Status Condition from the Target Vehicle.

general_commands.name: Roto-Repair
general_commands.effect: Heal the Target Vehicle for 5 HP.

general_commands.name: Roto-Restore
general_commands.effect: Remove the Disabled Status from the Target Vehicle.

general_commands.name: Run Down
general_commands.effect: Increase this Command’s Damage Dice by 1 for each additional point the Vehicle has in Dexterity.

general_commands.name: Toxic Artillery
general_commands.effect: Ranged. Projectile. Roll 4 Chance Dice to Poison the Foe and 2 other Targets.

general_commands.name: Trim The Main Sails
general_commands.effect: Increase the Vehicle's Dexterity by 2. Reduce its Defense and Special Defense by 1. Duration 3 Turns.
general_commands.requires: Sail Trait. 1 Crew; 6 Crew if Size Category Large or above.

general_commands.name: Unearthly Sublimation
general_commands.effect: Charge Command. Reaction 1. While in the Charge Phase, the Vehicle, any Active Combatants, or objects aboard it are immune to all Damage and other effects from sources not aboard the Vehicle itself.

general_commands.name: Wave Crest
general_commands.requires: 1 Crew; 5 Crew if Size Category Large or above.
